title: Defy Gravity
description: Mind-bending quantum levitation explained in under a minute

scenes.narration: Imagine objects floating in mid-air, defying gravity's pull
This is quantum levitation, where superconductors meet magnetic fields
When cooled, these materials expel magnetic fields, creating an upward force
The result is frictionless motion, with objects floating effortlessly
A phenomenon that could revolutionize transportation and engineering
And it's all thanks to the incredible power of quantum physics, where the impossible becomes possible
